text:
jen (rel-mgr): FYI merge window for release v0.12.3 closes in 45m. We need 2 approvals for PR #6123 — currently only @sara has approved.
release-bot: Scheduled cutover: 2026-03-17T16:00:00PT. Merge gate: approvals >=2.
sara: ping @liam — I left one comment but already approved, it's mostly nits.
liam: saw the ping, oncall handoff is in 30m but I can do a quick review in ~15.
mika: I can take the security pass now if needed, otherwise I can do perf check after lunch.
jen (rel-mgr): If we don't get the 2nd approval before cutoff, plan B is rollback to previous image and ship restart tomorrow AM. Need clear call by T-10m.
sara: @liam the non-blocking comment is about the kv-cache config flag — easy to change, but leaving as-is might change latency under long-context tests.
liam: quick grep for the flag... yeah it's here. I can add a one-line guard and re-run the unit tests.
mika: also double-checking the quantization matrices — I'll run a tiny perf job (20k tokens) now, should finish within 12m.
liam: pushed a tiny follow-up commit to address the guard: gh pr review --approve && gh pr comment -b "added guard for kv-cache" #6123
sara: ack, giving second approval now.
liam: approved.
release-bot: PR #6123 now has 2 approvals. Merge allowed before cutover.
jen (rel-mgr): Great — we still respect the canary rollout. @sara @liam thanks for the fast turnaround. I'll watch deploy logs and ping if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
mika: perf run looks green, no regressions in tail latency.
jen (rel-mgr): Merging now. Command: gh pr merge 6123 --squash --admin
liam: copying for audit: `git rev-parse HEAD` after merge to stamp the release.
release-bot: Merge complete. Deployed canary to 10% traffic. Monitoring dashboards: https://redwood.internal/d/ingress/release-v0.12.3
jen (rel-mgr): Canaries steady for 5m. Proceeding to 50% in 10m unless alerts. Thanks everyone.
sara: nice work, temporary guard removed in follow-up ticket #6201.
liam: filing post-merge notes in the PR thread.
jen (rel-mgr): Closing loop — if anything shows up, escalate to eng-oncall immediately.
